verdict.rationale: The only evidence of AI built into Shopify itself is a marketing line, "Design fast with AI", which implies some in-product AI help with store design but says nothing about an assistant that takes delegated tasks. The rest of the AI material (the AI Toolkit, the UCP/MCP agent servers) is for external coding tools and third-party agents, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: any documentation of a named in-admin AI assistant, the kinds of tasks it can perform, how users delegate and approve its actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
